scope: Single isolated candidate on Evo-X2 (gfx1151). Not a production switch. Retained llama-server stayed STOPPED; no same-condition baseline was measured.

model.verification: every file: publisher LFS SHA256 or Git blob SHA1; uncensor-preset/uncensor-think SHA256SUMS match

acquisition_attempts.reason: redirect host us.aws.cdn.hf.co not yet allowed
socket read timeout (180 s without data) during model-00004

preset.proof: engine log ' -- ablit runtime: spec <path> active (from EXL3_ABLIT_RUNTIME)' required before any request
preset.note: Runtime projection; weights unchanged. Different method and output distribution from the abliterated IQ4_XS GGUF. Preset OFF control not measured.

runs.outcome: stopped by original guard: swap growth 688 MiB > 512 MiB at 723 s while available was 25 GB
deliberately stopped (STOP file) after a scope change; 2 short requests
stopped by long-profile guard: swap used > 6 GiB 46 s into the cold-page-cache weight load (before KV allocation)
completed; guard exit 0; 147 requests / 37,632 reserved completion tokens; candidate lifetime 3,017 s including a 2,400 s-budget soak (15 cycles)

memory.note: UMA indicators are separate, not additive. The page cache holding the n-gram table is reclaimable and counted as available.

io.note: After READY n-gram row preads were served almost entirely from the page cache. dm-0 counters cover the whole device.

speed_bg10.unit: server timings median [min-max]; TTFT is client first content delta; tokens are actual post-template counts
speed_bg10.comparison_note: bg5 used ctx32768/sessions1/RAM n-gram; bg10 ctx262144/sessions2/disk n-gram. Same frozen prompts and request bodies. Disk mode was not slower here because the table pages were cached.

quality_bg10.needle: records A (first line, deepest), B, C quoted in order in every 8K/32K/128K prose reply
quality_bg10.code: AST-matched expected fix in every code reply; never executed
quality_bg10.explanations: sea-breeze explanations correct on manual review
quality_bg10.cache_note: One of five 128K prose replies differed: the warm request restored 127,744 cached tokens (page boundary) and its greedy text changed; cold runs and the full-hit warm run matched. Consistent with the engine's documented cache-restore divergence.
not_measured: general capability / uncensored efficacy beyond normal synthetic tasks

ctx131072_estimate: KV about 27.4 KB/token fp16: ctx131072 saves about 3.3 GiB versus ctx262144, so steady available would be about 42 GiB under the same disk n-gram setup (estimate, not measured).
